messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated model-load failures for model:redwood-6b-quant in region:us-east1. ~37% warmup attempts erroring with CUDA allocation errors and decompression/deser failures. Possible node crashes observed. Severity: high :rotating_light:

priya (eng-runtime): jumping in. Pattern: nodes trying to mmap artifact shards then lz4_decompress returning -22 followed by 'cuMemMap' failures and `cuCtxLock` warnings. Example logs:
```
  artifact_loader: mmap shard-5 size=1.2GB -> ok
  artifact_loader: lz4_decompress shard-5 -> error -22
  gpu_init: cuMemAlloc failed (out of memory) at 0x7f8c... err=701
  runtime: failed to bind GPU memory after decompress
  container: process exit code 137
```

sanjay (oncall): ack. I'm on call. Are requests failing or just warmups? Any customer impact metrics?

noah (sre): we have node flaps in us-east1-a and us-east1-c. Kube events show OOMKill on container runtime and GPU driver resets (nvidia-smi shows aborted on some nodes). Monitoring: generation latency spikes and a small surge in 502s while routing redistributes. Top-line: region availability ~91% over last 5m.

lucas (prod): customer impact: a handful of higher-tier customers report errors on batch generation. No data leak. CS tickets rising. Emma coordinating comms.

priya (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations I'd recommend: 1) pause eager warmup for redwood-6b-quant in us-east1 to stop stampede. 2) set per-pool init concurrency to 1 so autoscaler doesn't start loads in parallel. 3) enable fallback routing to redwood-3b-quant-v2 for requests; mark 6b as degraded. 4) collect a crash dump from a failed node before rebooting any more.

sanjay (oncall): applying 1 and 2 now. ops-bot, please flip warmup off and adjust autoscaler.

ops-bot: running: ```redwoodctl model set-warmup --model redwood-6b-quant --region us-east1 --enabled false```
ops-bot: running: ```redwoodctl pool set-init-concurrency --pool us-east1-6b --value 1```
ops-bot: completed both commands. Warmup paused.

priya (eng-runtime): good. Also adding a short-term tweak: increase deserial buffer and retry logic to treat lz4_decompress errors as transient on canary only. Will push a runtime patch to avoid repeated concurrent retries that starve GPU memory.

noah (sre): taking affected nodes OOS to get full driver logs. Found repeated messages: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:xx:xx): 79` followed by container termination. Suspect decompress peak memory plus mapping leads to driver OOM.

deploy-bot: artifact rebuild queued: `artifact-2026-06-redwood6b-shard128-lz4fix` (shard_size=128MB, lz4-block=64KB, deser_timeout=75s). ETA ~50m for build and smoke.

lucas (prod): Emma, drafting customer note: we will route to 3b variant and ETA for re-enable ~4 hours pending canary success. Please confirm wording.

emma (cs): drafting outbound and internal incident ticker. Will tell customers temporary fallback to 3b, no change to billing, and ETA once canary completes.

priya (eng-runtime): action for artifact team: repackage with smaller shard size and alternate compression (try lz4 with smaller blocksize). Also add checksum verify pre-decompress to catch truncated artifacts earlier. I'll open a follow-up issue.

noah (sre): once canary artifact is ready, recommend rolling to a single canary AZ (us-east1-b) with new artifact and monitor driver reset counts for 30m. If stable, roll with 20m staggers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staged build started: build-912. Canary target pool: us-east1-canary-2.

incident-bot: Incident update: warmup paused, fallback routing enabled. Region availability improved to 95% after mitigation, error rate dropping.

sanjay (oncall): quick note: capturing handoff. I'm staying to coordinate until canary proves stable. If anyone needs to leave, call me.

deploy-bot: build-912 finished and artifact pushed to canary. Artifact id: artifact-912-202606. Canaries starting.

priya (eng-runtime): canary warmup logs: ```canary-2: download ok, verify checksum ok, decompress blocks ok, deserializing shards... compile: avg 7.9s, no cuMemAlloc failures. warmup success x3```

noah (sre): canary observed no driver Xid events for 25m. rolling to us-east1-a with 20m stagger. marking previous flaky nodes for deeper diag.

lucas (prod): CS wants exact time we can re-enable warmup in full region; any estimate?

priya (eng-runtime): timeline: canary -> roll AZs (20m per AZ) -> monitor 30m after final AZ. Expect ~3.5-4 hours to full re-enable. We'll keep fallback routing until final verification.

emma (cs): sending update to customers: new ETA 4h, fallback in place, engineers working on artifact repack and runtime fixes.

noah (sre): note: root-cause hypothesis for postmortem: artifact shard sizing + compression blocksize causes decompress working set to spike > GPU driver soft limit during mmap/decompress, triggering driver reset. Also autoscaler allowed concurrent inits which multiplied peak usage. Recommendations: change packager defaults, add warmup concurrency guard, add preflight checksum+decompress dry-run, and improve telemetry for driver Xid correlates.

priya (eng-runtime): adding follow-ups: - ship runtime patch to backoff on lz4_decompress errors and avoid retry loops, - adjust artifact packager to smaller shard defaults for quantized models, - add canary gating to artifact rollouts.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: mitigations verified after roll. Postmortem owner: priya (eng-runtime). Follow-ups filed: ARTIFACT-421, RUNTIME-112, SRE-98.

lucas (prod): thanks all for fast coordination. Good work. Closing comms once postmortem doc and customer follow-ups posted. :white_check_mark:
